value.text: 2026-05-29 hands-on lifecycle note: exercised built pm-slack hook without real Slack secrets. Missing PM_SLACK_WEBHOOK produced a clear disabled notification log and did not interrupt the underlying command path. Mocked create event with priority 1 posted JSON containing the expected item title and mrkdwn flag to a fake HTTPS responder; webhook path was redacted in audit output. Mocked close event with HTTP 500 logged Failed to send Slack notification and still returned without throwing. No real customer payloads or secret values were used or printed.
